info.title: Octo HTML Docs API
info.description: Agent-facing surface for octo-doc — the self-hosted, prompt-native interactive HTML document service (distinct from the CRDT docs-backend behind the `docs` domain). Covers the document lifecycle (publish/list/get/versions/delete), author drafts, per-doc share codes, media assets, inline comments, and the agent element read/replace + reply paths. All paths are under the `/docs-html/v1` prefix and return the `{data}/{error}` envelope.

get.description: Owner-scoped document index. The owner check is enforced server-side; a non-owner session is rejected 403.

slug.description: Canonical doc_id for a mounted document; legacy slug for an unmounted document.

post.summary: Publish an HTML document (creates or bumps a version)
post.description: Publish a self-contained HTML document. With a group, space, or thread mount, the first publish synchronously registers the document and returns its canonical doc_id; repeating the alias resolves to that same document and doc_id. Later publishes may pass the canonical doc_id in slug. Without a mount (or with an empty mount), compatibility behavior is unchanged: the document is not registered, remains addressed by its legacy slug, and returns no usable doc_id. Use doc_id for non-publish operations on registered documents and the legacy slug for unregistered documents. Requires the write token (Bearer). The server stamps commentable artifacts and reconciles existing comment anchors.

slug.description: Human-readable alias on the first mounted publish. Reusing the alias resolves to the same document and returns the same doc_id; a later mounted publish may instead pass that canonical ID. In unmounted/empty-mount compatibility mode this remains the legacy slug and no usable doc_id is returned.

html.description: the full self-contained HTML document body

version.description: optional explicit version; omit to auto-increment

mount_type.description: Mount used to synchronously register the first publish in docs-backend and the file sidebar; 'group', 'space', and 'thread' are supported. Omit or leave empty only for legacy unregistered, slug-addressed compatibility; that mode returns no usable doc_id.

doc_id.description: Canonical document identifier returned for mounted documents; pass it to every non-publish HTML command. Empty or absent in legacy unmounted mode.

alias.description: Human-readable alias requested on first mounted publish; may be absent in legacy mode.

slug.description: Compatibility value equal to doc_id for mounted documents, or the legacy slug for unmounted documents.

get.description: Return a single document's metadata (slug, title, latest version, timestamps). Backend endpoint GET /docs-html/v1/docs/{doc_id} — added to octo-doc to back this command.

get.summary: List a document's per-uid access grants (author-only)
get.description: List the uids granted access to this document and their role. Author-only (only the doc creator can view grants).

parameters.name: doc_id
parameters.description: Canonical doc_id returned by a mounted publish; use the legacy slug for an unmounted document.

put.summary: Grant a uid access to a document (author-only)
put.description: Grant a specific uid access to this document (upsert by uid). role defaults to 'reader' (read published versions + comment/react). Only the doc creator (author) can grant. The granted uid resolves to a reader capability on subsequent requests — no share code needed.

parameters.name: doc_id
parameters.description: Canonical doc_id returned by a mounted publish; use the legacy slug for an unmounted document.

uid.description: the uid to grant access to

role.description: capability to grant; defaults to 'reader' when omitted

delete.description: Revoke a uid's grant on this document. Author-only. The doc creator cannot be removed (they own the doc) — attempting to returns a conflict.

post.summary: Create a comment on a document (needs reader capability)
post.description: Create a comment anchored to text or an artifact aid. Requires at least a reader capability (the doc's share code) or the write token.

post.summary: Post an agent reply + verdict to a comment (write-token gated)
post.description: Reply to a comment thread as the agent (identity odoc-agent) with an optional verdict: applied / partial / question. Requires the write token.

post.summary: Read one artifact's outer HTML by aid (write-token gated)
post.description: Return the outer HTML of a single artifact located by its stamped data-odoc-aid in a document version (version 0 = latest). Requires the write token.

slug.description: Canonical doc_id for a mounted document, or the legacy slug for an unmounted document. The wire name remains slug for server compatibility.

version.description: version to read; 0 or omitted = latest

post.summary: Replace one artifact's outer HTML by aid and republish (write-token gated)
post.description: Swap one artifact's outer HTML (located by aid in base_version, 0 = latest) with new_html and republish a new version. new_html must be exactly one top-level element and free of scripts / inline event handlers / javascript: URLs. Requires the write token.

base_version.description: version whose aid to locate; 0 or omitted = latest
